How did life expectancy vary across countries in 2007?



The Gapminder teaching extract contains country observations from 1952 to 2007. We filter to 2007 and compare country values.






Countries in 2007 show an overall positive association between GDP per person and life expectancy.


Source: Gapminder teaching extract. This example chart is supplied from Week 3. Replace it with your own work when ready.
